exposure: Percutaneous thrombectomy (pharmacomechanical thrombolysis or catheter-directed thrombolysis)
outcome: Recanalization rate of lower extremity veins
cohort: The study included 72 postpartum women with continuous acute symptomatic iliofemoral deep vein thrombosis.
finding: Lower extremity venous thrombectomy is a safe and effective treatment for postpartum iliofemoral venous thrombosis, improving vein patency and reducing postthrombotic syndrome incidence compared to anticoagulation alone.
